2607.29363.title: Stable Autoregressive Speech Generation with Low-Frame-Rate High-Dimensional Continuous Tokens
2607.29363.paper_summary: Balancing sequence length, representational capacity, and long-horizon stability is a central problem in autoregressive (AR) speech and audio generation. Representations with higher frame rates or greater capacity can preserve more signal detail, but they also make streaming generation more vulnerable to distribution drift and AR error accumulation. Conversely, shorter and more compressed representations simplify AR modeling, but their limited bandwidth may discard important components and constrain the upper bound of reconstruction fidelity and generation quality. We ask whether a low-frame-rate, high-dimensional, high-bandwidth continuous representation can be co-designed with a streaming generation framework to support robust high-fidelity reconstruction, strong single-token predictability, and superior long-horizon stability. We decompose this goal into two coupled problems: what geometric and statistical properties a high-dimensional representation space should have, and how an AR continuous-token generator should be structured to resist error accumulation. Accordingly, we propose Locodec, a locally encoded codec that shapes its representation space to improve the interpolatability of a lower-dimensional core manifold and the identifiability of the native high-dimensional coordinates, thereby improving the predictability of high-dimensional high-bandwidth tokens. We also propose MP-ELD, a single-token AR flow-matching framework that uses multi-path information routing and residual classifier-free guidance to mitigate error accumulation. Experiments with 8-Hz, 768-dimensional tokens show that our design preserves reconstruction quality, improves single-token predictability, achieves competitive WER, and maintains stable long-form synthesis, without using external SSL/ASR models, pretrained text language models, or post-training stages.
2607.29363.paper_summary_zh: 平衡序列長度、表徵能力和長期穩定性是自回歸（AR）語音和音頻生成中的一個核心問題。具有更高幀率或更大容量的表徵可以保留更多的信號細節，但它們也使串流生成更容易受到分佈漂移和AR錯誤累積的影響。相反，較短且更壓縮的表徵簡化了AR建模，但其有限的帶寬可能會丟棄重要組件，並限制重建保真度和生成質量的上限。我們探討是否可以將低幀率、高維度、高帶寬的連續表徵與串流生成框架共同設計，以支持穩健的高保真重建、強單標記可預測性和卓越的長期穩定性。我們將這一目標分解為兩個相互關聯的問題：高維表徵空間應具備什麼幾何和統計特性，以及AR連續標記生成器應如何結構以抵抗錯誤累積。因此，我們提出了Locodec，一種局部編碼編解碼器，該編解碼器塑造其表徵空間，以改善低維核心流形的插值性和原生高維坐標的可識別性，從而提高高維高帶寬標記的可預測性。我們還提出了MP-ELD，一種單標記AR流匹配框架，該框架利用多路徑信息路由和殘差無分類器引導來減輕錯誤累積。對8-Hz、768維標記的實驗表明，我們的設計保持了重建質量，提高了單標記可預測性，實現了具有競爭力的WER，並在不使用外部SSL/ASR模型、預訓練文本語言模型或後訓練階段的情況下維持穩定的長篇合成。
